name: West paperless enrollment
offer: A bill credit for switching to paperless billing.
outcome: Enrollment rose among households already on autopay.

name: Central premium-channel weekend
offer: One free premium channel for a weekend.
constraint: Limit the offer to one weekend.
outcome: Redemptions came from households that already subscribed to video.

name: In-term second mobile line
offer: A discount on adding a mobile line.
constraint: Offer the discount only while the current contract is in term.
outcome: Adds were mostly a second line.

name: Standard-tier loyalty credit
offer: A one-time credit after two years on the standard internet tier.
constraint: Do not extend the credit to the gig or basic tiers.
outcome: Credits went to households past the two-year mark on the standard tier.
